explanation: Each TTree hit = 1 detected PE (Geant4 applies PDE as Bernoulli filter). pde branch records the PDE value at detection wavelength (metadata only). Convention: Npe_per_end = mean hits with face_type=0 (END_LEFT) per event; END_LEFT ≈ END_RIGHT by symmetry.

npe_tir_x0.note: scan_end_tir run used dielectric_metal surface (EXEC_21 bug), which eliminates TIR. Data are INVALID for physics comparison.
